1.1: Shenayim ochazin betallit, ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha, ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli, ze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veyachaloku. ze omer kullah shelli veze omer chetzyah shelli, haomer kullah shelli, yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mishshelosha chalakim, vehaomer chetzyah shelli, yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mervia. ze notel shelosha chalakim, veze notel revia:
1.2: Hayu shenayim rochvin al gabbe vehema, o shehaya echad rochev veechad manhig, ze omer kullah shelli, veze omer kullah shelli, ze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veyachaloku. bizman shehem modim o sheyyesh lahen edim, cholkim belo shevua:
1.3: Haya rochev al gabbe vehema veraa et hammetzia, veamar lachavero teneha li, netalah veamar ani zachiti vah, zacha vah. im mishshennetanah lo amar ani zachiti vah techilla, lo amar kelum:
1.4: Raa et hammetzia venafal aleha, uva acher vehechezik bah, ze shehechezik bah zacha vah. raa otan ratzin achar metzia, achar tzevi shavur, achar gozalot shello farchu, veamar zachta li sadi, zachta lo. haya tzevi ratz kedarko, o shehayu gozalot mafrichin, veamar zachta li sadi, lo amar kelum:
1.5: Metziat beno uvitto hakketannim, metziat avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, metziat ishto, hare ellu shello. metziat beno uvitto haggedolim, metziat avdo veshifchato haivrim, metziat ishto sheggershah, af al pi shello natan ketubbatah, hare ellu shellahen:
1.6: Matza shetare chov, im yesh bahen acharayut nechasim, lo yachazir, shebbet din nifrain mehen, en bahen acharayut nechasim, yachazir, sheen bet din nifrain mehen, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ben kach uven kach lo yachazir, mippene shebbet din nifrain mehen:
1.7: Matza gitte nashim, veshichrure avadim, deyateke, mattana veshovrim, hare ze lo yachazir, sheani omer ketuvim hayu venimlach alehem shello littenam:
1.8: Matza iggerot shum veiggerot mazon, shetare chalitza umeunin, ushetare verurin, vechol maase vet din, hare ze yachazir. matza vachafisa o vidluskema, tachrich shel shetarot, o agudda shel shetarot, hare ze yachazir. vechamma agudda shel shetarot, shelosha keshurin ze vaze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, echad hallove mishshelosha, yachazir lallove, shelosha hallovin meechad, yachazir lammalve. matza shetar ben shetarotav veeno yodea ma tivo, yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. im yesh immahen simponot, yaase ma shebbassimponot:

2.1: Ellu metziot shello, veellu chayyav lehacheriz. ellu metziot shello, matza ferot mefuzzarin, maot mefuzzarot, kerichot birshut harabbim, veiggule devela, kikkarot shel nachtom, macharozot shel dagim, vachatichot shel basar, vegizze tzemer habbaot mimmedinatan, vaanitze fishtan, uleshonot shel argaman, hare ellu shello, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, kol sheyyesh bo shinnuy, chayyav lehacheriz. ketzad. matza iggul uvetocho cheres, kikkar uvetocho maot. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, kol kele enporya eno chayyav lehacheriz:
2.2: Veelu chayyav lehacheriz, matza ferot bichli o cheli kemot shehu, maot bechis o chis kemot shehu, tzibbure ferot, tzibbure maot, shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze, kerichot birshut hayyachid, vechikkarot shel baal habbayit, vegizze tzemer hallekuchot mibbet haumman, kadde yayin vechadde shemen, hare ellu chayyav lehacheriz:
2.3: Matza achar haggappa o achar haggader gozalot mekushsharin, o vishvilin shebbassadot, hare ze lo yigga bahen. matza cheli baashpa, im mechusse, lo yigga bo, im megulle, notel umachriz. matza vegal o vechotel yashan, hare ellu shello. matza vechotel chadash, mechetzyo velachutz, shello, mechetzyo velifnim, shel baal habbayit. im haya maskiro laacherim, afillu vetoch habbayit, hare ellu shello:
2.4: Matza vachanut, hare ellu shello. ben hatteva velachenvani, shel chenvani. lifne shulchani, hare ellu shello. ben hakkisse velashshulchani, hare ellu lashshulchani. hallokeach perot mechavero o sheshshalach lo chavero perot, umatza vahen maot, hare ellu shello. im hayu tzerurin, notel umachriz:
2.5: Af hassimla hayta vichlal kol elle. lamma yatzat. lehakkish eleha, lomar lecha, ma simla meyuchedet sheyyesh bah simanim veyesh lah tovim, af kol davar sheyyesh bo simanim veyesh lo tovim, chayyav lehacheriz:
2.6: Vead matay chayyav lehacheriz. ad kede sheyyedu vo shechenav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shalosh regalim, veachar haregel haacharon shiva yamim, kede sheyyelech leveto shelosha veyachazor shelosha veyachriz yom echad:
2.7: Amar et haaveda velo amar simaneha, lo yitten lo. veharammay, af al pi sheamar simaneha, lo yitten lo, shenneemar (Devarim 22) ad derosh achicha oto, ad shettidrosh et achicha im rammay hu im eno rammay. kol davar sheose veochel, yaase veyochal. vedavar sheen ose veochel, yimmacher, shenneemar (sham) vahashevoto lo, ree heach teshivennu lo. ma yehe vaddamim. rabbi tarfon omer, yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu chayyav beacharayutan. rabbi akiva omer, lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan:
2.8: Matza sefarim, kore vahen achat lishloshim yom. veim eno yodea likrot, gollan. aval lo yilmod bahen battechilla, velo yikra acher immo. matza chesut, menaarah achat lishloshim yom. veshotchah letzarkah, aval lo lichvodo. kele chesef uchele nechoshet, mishtammesh bahen letzarkan, aval lo leshochokan. kele zahav uchele zechuchit, lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. matza sak o kuppa, vechol davar sheen darko littol, hare ze lo yittol:
2.9: Ezo hi aveda, matza chamor o fara roin badderech, en zo aveda. chamor vechelav hafuchin, para ratza ben hakkeramim, hare zo aveda. hechezirah uvarcha, hechezirah uvarcha, afilu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, chayyav lehachazirah, shenneemar (Devarim 22) hashev teshivem. haya vatel missela, lo yomar lo ten li sela, ella noten lo secharo kefoel batel. im yesh sham bet din, matne bifne vet din. im en sham bet din, bifne mi yatne, shello kodem:
2.10: Metzaah barefet, eno chayyav bah. birshut harabbim, chayyav bah. veim hayta vet hakkevarot, lo yittamma lah. im amar lo aviv, hittamme, o sheamar lo, al tachazir, lo yishma lo. parak vetaan, parak vetaan, afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, chayyav, shenneemar (Shemot 23) azov taazov. halach veyashav lo veamar, hoil vealecha mitzva, im retzoncha lifrok perok, patur, shenneemar, immo. im haya zaken o chole, chayyav. mitzva min hattora lifrok, aval lo liton. rabbi shimon omer, af liton. rabbi yose haggelili omer, im haya alav yater al massao, en zakuk lo, shenneemar, tachat massao, masseoy sheyyachol laamod bo:
2.11: Avedato vaavedat aviv, avedato kodemet. avedato vaavedat rabbo, shello kodemet. avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo, shel rabbo kodemet, sheaviv hevio laolam hazze, verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba. veim aviv chacham, shel aviv kodemet. haya aviv verabbo nosin masseoy, meniach et shel rabbo. veachar kach meniach et shel aviv. haya aviv verabbo bevet hashshevi, pode et rabbo, veachar kach pode et aviv. veim haya aviv chacham, pode et aviv, veachar kach pode et rabbo:

3.1: Hammafkid etzel chavero behema o chelim, venignevu o sheavdu, shillem velo ratza lishshava, shehare amru shomer chinnam nishba veyotze, nimtza haggannav, meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem, lemi shehappikkadon etzlo. nishba velo ratza leshallem, nimtza haggannav, meshallem tashlume chefel, tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem, levaal happikkadon:
3.2: Hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher, umeta chedarka, yishshava hassocher shemmeta chedarka, vehashshoel yeshallem lassocher. amar rabbi yose, ketzad halla ose sechora befarato shel chavero, ella tachazor para labbealim:
3.3: Amar lishnayim, gazalti leechad mikkem mane, veeni yodea eze mikkem, o, aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid li mane, veeni yodea eze hu, noten laze mane velaze mane, shehoda mippi atzmo:
3.4: Shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad, ze mane veze matayim, ze omer shelli matayim veze omer shelli matayim, noten laze mane velaze mane, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. amar rabbi yose, im ken ma hifsid harammay. ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu:
3.5: Vechen shene chelim, echad yafe mane veechad yafe elef zuz, ze omer yafe shelli veze omer yafe shelli, noten et hakkatan leechad mehen, umittoch haggadol noten deme katan lashsheni, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. amar rabbi yose, im ken ma hifsid harammay. ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu:
3.6: Hammafkid perot etzel chavero, afillu hen avudin lo yigga bahen. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, mochran bifne vet din, mippene shehu chemeshiv aveda labbealim:
3.7: Hammafkid perot etzel chavero, hare ze yotzi lo chesronot. lechittin uleorez, tisha chatzae kabbin lechor, lisorin uledochan, tisha kabbin lechor, lechusmin ulezera pishtan, shalosh sein lechor. hakkol lefi hammidda, hakkol lefi hazzeman. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, vechi ma ichpat lahen laachbarin, vahalo ochlot ben meharebe uven mikkima. ella eno motzi lo chesronot ella lechor echad bilvad. rabbi yehuda omer, im hayta midda merubba, eno motzi lo chesronot, mippene shemmotirot:
3.8: Yotzi lo shetut leyayin. rabbi yehuda omer, chomesh. yotzi lo sheloshet luggin shemen lemea, log umechetza shemarim, log umechetza bala. im haya shemen mezukkak, eno motzi lo shemarim. im hayu kankannim yeshanim, eno motzi lo bala. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammocher shemen mezukkak lachavero kol yemot hashshana, hare ze mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim lemea:
3.9: Hammafkid chavit etzel chavero, velo yichadu lah habbealim makom, vetiltelah venishbera, im mittoch yado nishbera, letzarko, chayyav, letzarkah, patur. im mishshehinnichah nishbera, ben letzarko ben letzarkah, patur. yichadu lah habbealim makom, vetiltelah venishbera, ben mittoch yado uven mishshehinnichah, letzarko, chayyav, letzarkah, patur:
3.10: Hammafkid maot etzel chavero, tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav, o shemmesaran livno ulevitto hakketannim, venaal bifnehem shello charauy, chayyav, shello shamar kederech hashshomrim. veim shamar kederech hashshomrim, patur:
3.11: Hammafkid maot etzel shulchani, im tzerurin, lo yishtammesh bahem, lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan, muttarin, yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu chayyav beacharayutan. etzel baal habbayit, ben tzerurin uven muttarim lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan. chenvani kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, chenvani kashshulchani:
3.12: Hashsholeach yad befikkadon, bet shammay omrim, yilke vechaser uveyater. uvet hillel omrim, kishat hotzaa. rabbi akiva omer, kishat hattevia. hachoshev lishloach yad befikkadon, bet shammay omrim, chayyav. uvet hillel omrim, eno chayyav ad sheyyishlach bo yad, shenneemar (Shemot 22) im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu. ketzad. hitta et hechavit venatal hemenna reviit, venishbera, eno meshallem ella reviit. higbihah venatal hemenna reviit, venishbera, meshallem deme chullah:

4.1: Hazzahav kone et hakkesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hazzahav. hannechoshet kona et hakkesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hannechoshet. maot haraot konot et hayyafot, vehayyafot enan konot et haraot. asimon kone et hammatbea, vehammatbea eno kone et asimon. mittaltelin konim et hammatbea, vehammatbea eno kone et hammittaltelin. ze hakkelal, kol hammittaltelin konin ze et ze:
4.2: Ketzad. mashach hemennu ferot velo natan lo maot, eno yachol lachazor bo. natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu ferot, yachol lachazor bo. aval amru, mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umiddor happallaga, hu atid lehippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo. rabbi shimon omer, kol shehakkesef beyado, yado al haelyona:
4.3: Haonaa, arbaa chesef meesrim vearbaa chesef lassela, shetut lammikkach. ad matay muttar lehachazir. ad kede sheyyare letaggar o likrovo. hora rabbi tarfon belod, haonaa shemona chesef lassela, shelish lammikkach, vesamchu taggare lod. amar lahem, kol hayyom muttar lehachazir. amru lo, yanniach lanu rabbi tarfon bimkomenu, vechazru ledivre chachamim:
4.4: Echad hallokeach veechad hammocher, yesh lahen onaa. keshem sheonaa lehedyot, kach onaa letaggar. rabbi yehuda omer, en onaa letaggar. mi shehuttal alav, yado al haelyona, ratza, omer ten li meotay, o ten li ma sheonitani:
4.5: Kamma tehe hassela chasera velo yehe vah onaa. rabbi meir omer, arbaa issarin, issar ledinar. rabbi yehuda omer, arbaa fundeyonot, pundeyon ledinar. rabbi shimon omer, shemona fundeyonot, shene fundeyonot ledinar:
4.6: Ad matay muttar lehachazir, bakkerakkim, ad kede sheyyare leshulchani, uvakkefarim, ad arve shabbatot. im haya makkirah, afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh mekabbelah hemennu, veen lo alav ella taromet. venotnah lemaaser sheni veeno choshesh, sheeno ella nefesh raa:
4.7: Haonaa arbaa chesef, vehattaana shete chesef, vehahodaa shave feruta. chamesh perutot hen. hahodaa shave feruta, vehaishsha mitkaddeshet beshave feruta, vehannehene veshave feruta min hahekdesh maal, vehammotze shave feruta chayyav lehacheriz, vehaggozel et chavero shave feruta venishba lo, yolichennu acharav afillu lemaday:
4.8: Chamishsha chumshin hen. haochel teruma, uterumat maaser, uterumat maaser shel demay, vehachalla, vehabbikkurim mosif chomesh. vehappode neta revai umaaser sheni shello, mosif chomesh. happode et hekdesho, mosif chomesh. hannehene veshave feruta min hahekdesh, mosif chomesh. vehaggozel et chavero shave feruta venishba lo, mosif chomesh:
4.9: Ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa. haavadim, vehashshetarot, vehakkarkaot, vehahekdeshot. en lahen lo tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, shomer chinnam eno nishba, venose sachar eno meshallem. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim shehu chayyav beacharayutan, yesh lahen onaa, vesheeno chayyav beacharayutan, en lahen onaa. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammocher sefer tora, behema umargalit, en lahem onaa. amru lo, lo amru ella et ellu:
4.10: Keshem sheonaa vemikkach umimkar, kach onaa vidvarim. lo yomar lo bechamma chefetz ze, vehu eno rotze likkach. im haya vaal teshuva, lo yomar lo zechor maasecha harishonim. im hu ven gerim, lo yomar lo zechor maase avotecha, shenneemar (Shemot 22) veger lo tone velo tilchatzennu:
4.11: En mearvin perot beferot, afillu chadashim bachadashim, veen tzarich lomar chadashim bishanim. beemet, beyayin hittiru learev kashe verach, mippene shehu mashbicho. en mearvin shimre yayin beyayin, aval noten lo et shemarav. mi shennitarev mayim beyeno, lo yimkerennu vachanut ella im ken hodio, velo letaggar af al pi shehodio, sheeno ella lerammot bo. mekom shennahagu lehattil mayim bayyayin, yattilu:
4.12: Hattaggar notel mechamesh geranot venoten letoch megura achat. mechamesh gittot, venoten letoch pittam echad. uvilvad shello yehe mitkavven learev. rabbi yehuda omer, lo yechallek hachenvani kelayot veegozin lattinokot, mippene shehu margilan lavo etzlo. vachachamim mattirin. velo yifchot et hashshaar. vachachamim omrim, zachur latov. lo yavor et haggerisin, divre abba shaul. vachachamim mattirin. umodim shello yavor meal pi megura, sheeno ella chegonev et haayin. en mefarkesin lo et haadam velo et habbehema velo et hakkelim:

5.1: Ezehu neshech veezehu tarbit. ezehu neshech. hammalve sela bachamishsha dinarin, satayim chittin beshalosh, mippene shehu noshech. veezehu tarbit, hammarbe beferot. ketzad. lakach hemennu chittin bedinar zahav hakkor, vechen hashshaar, amdu chittin bishloshim dinarin, amar lo ten li chittay, sheani rotze lemachran velikkach bahen yayin. amar lo hare chittecha asuyot alay bishloshim, vahare lecha etzli bahen yayin, veyayin en lo:
5.2: Hammalve et chavero, lo yadur bachatzero chinnam, velo yiskor mimmennu befachot, mippene shehu ribbit. marbin al hassachar, veen marbin al hammecher. ketzad. hiskir lo et chatzero, veamar lo, im meachshav atta noten li, hare hu lecha beeser selaim leshana, veim shel chodesh bechodesh, besela lechodesh, muttar. machar lo et sadehu, veamar lo, im meachshav atta noten li, hare hi shellecha beelef zuz, im laggoren, bishnem asar mane, asur:
5.3: Machar lo et hassade, venatan lo miktzat damim, veamar lo ematay shettirtze have maot vetol et shellecha, asur. hilvahu al sadehu, veamar lo, im i atta noten li mikkan vead shalosh shanim hare hi shelli, hare hi shello. vechach haya baytos ben zonin ose al pi chachamim:
5.4: En moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar, velo yitten maot likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar, ella im ken noten lo secharo kefoel. en moshivin tarnegolin lemechetza, veen shamin agalin useyachin lemechetza, ella im ken noten lo sechar amalo umezono. aval mekabbelin agalin useyachin lemechetza, umegaddelin otan ad sheyyehu meshullashin. vachamor, ad shettehe toanet:
5.5: Shamin para vachamor vechol davar shehu ose veochel lemechetza. mekom shennahagu lachalok et havveladot miyyad, cholkin, mekom shennahagu legaddel, yegaddelu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shamin egel im immo useyach im immo. umafriz al sadehu, veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit:
5.6: En mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael, mippene shehu ribbit. aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min hannachrim, velovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit, vechen beger toshav. malve yisrael meotav shel nachri middaat hannachri, aval lo middaat yisrael:
5.7: En poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar. (yatza hashshaar, poskin, veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze). haya hu techilla lakkotzrim, posek immo al haggadish, veal heavit shel anavim, veal hammaatan shel zetim, veal habbetzim shel yotzer, veal hassid mishsheshshikkeo vakkivshan. ufosek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana. rabbi yose omer, en poskin al hazzevel ella im ken hayta lo zevel baashpa. vachachamim mattirin. ufosek immo cheshaar haggavoah. rabbi yehuda omer, af al pi shello fasak immo cheshaar haggavoah, yachol lomar ten li chaze, o ten li meotay:
5.8: Malve adam et arisav chittim bechittin lezera, aval lo leechol. shehaya rabban gamliel malve et arisav chittin bechittin lezera, beyoker vehuzelu, o vezol vehukeru, notel mehen keshaar hazzol, velo mippene shehalacha chen, ella sheratza lehachemir al atzmo:
5.9: Lo yomar adam lachavero, haleveni chor chittin vaani etten lecha laggoren. aval omer lo, haleveni ad sheyyavo veni, o ad sheemtza mafteach. vehillel oser. vechen haya hillel omer, lo talve ishsha kikkar lachavertah ad shettaasennu damim, shemma yokiru chittim, venimtzeu vaot lide ribbit:
5.10: Omer adam lachavero, nakkesh immi vaanakkesh immach, ador immi veedor immach, velo yomar lo nakkesh immi veedor immach, ador immi vaanakkesh immach. kol yeme garid, echad. kol yeme revia, echad. lo yomar lo charosh immi baggarid vaani echerosh immecha barvia. rabban gamliel omer, yesh ribbit mukdemet veyesh ribbit meucheret. ketzad. natan enav lilvot hemennu, vehaya meshalleach lo veomer bishvil shettalveni, zo hi ribbit mukdemet. lava hemennu vehechezir lo et meotav, vehaya meshalleach lo veamar bishvil meotecha shehayu vetelot etzli, zo hi ribbit meucheret. rabbi shimon omer, yesh ribbit devarim, lo yomar lo, da ki va ish peloni mimmakom peloni:
5.11: Veellu ovrin belo taase. hammalve, vehallove, vehearev, vehaedim. vachachamim omrim, af hassofer. ovrim mishshum lo titten (Vayikra 25), umishshum bal tikkach meitto (sham), umishshum lo tihye lo kenoshe (Shemot 22), umishshum lo tesimun alav neshech (sham), umishshum velifne ivver lo titten michshol veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai (Vayikra 19):

6.1: Hassocher et haummanin, vehitu ze et ze, en lahem ze al ze ella taromet. sachar et hachammar veet hakkaddar lehavi firyafrin vachalilim lakkalla o lammet, ufoalin lehaalot pishtano min hammishra, vechol davar sheaved, vechazru vahen, mekom sheen sham adam, socher alehen o matan:
6.2: Hassocher et haummanin vechazru vahen, yadan al hattachtona. im baal habbayit chozer bo, yado al hattachtona. kol hameshanne, yado al hattachtona. vechol hachozer bo, yado al hattachtona:
6.3: Hassocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholichah babbika, babbika veholichah bahar, afillu zo eser milin vezo eser milin, vameta, chayyav. hassocher et hachamor vehivrika, o shennaaset angarya, omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha. meta o nishbera, chayyav lehaamid lo chamor. hassocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholichah babbika, im hechelika, patur, veim huchamma, chayyav. leholichah babbika veholichah bahar, im hechelika, chayyav, veim huchamma, patur. im mechamat hammaala, chayyav:
6.4: Hassocher et happara lacharosh bahar vecharash babbika, im nishbar hakkankan, patur. babbika vecharash bahar, im nishbar hakkankan, chayyav. ladush bakkitnit vedash battevua, patur, ladush battevua vedash bakkitnit, chayyav, mippene shehakkitnit machalaket:
6.5: Hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha chittim vehevi aleha seorim, chayyav. tevua vehevi aleha teven, chayyav, mippene shehannefach kashe lammasseoy. lehavi letech chittim vehevi letech seorim, patur. veim hosif al massao, chayyav. vechamma yosif al massao vihe chayyav. sumechos omer mishshum rabbi meir, sea legamal, shelosha kabbin lachamor:
6.6: Kol haummanin, shomre sachar hen. vechullan sheamru, tol et shellecha vehave maot, shomer chinnam. shemor li veeshmor lach, shomer sachar. shemor li, veamar lo hannach lefanay, shomer chinnam:
6.7: Hilvahu al hammashkon, shomer sachar. rabbi yehuda omer, hilvahu maot, shomer chinnam. hilvahu perot, shomer sachar. abba shaul omer, muttar adam lehasekir mashkono shel ani lihyot posek alav veholech, mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda:
6.8: Hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom ushevarah, ben shomer chinnam ben shomer sachar, yishshava. rabbi eliezer omer, ze veze yishshava, vetameah ani im yecholin ze vaze lishshavea:

7.1: Hassocher et happoalim veamar lahem lehashekim ulehaariv, mekom shennahagu shello lehashekim veshello lehaariv, eno rashshay lechofan. mekom shennahagu lazun, yazun. lesappek bimtika, yesappek. hakkol keminhag hammedina. maase berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno, tze sechor lanu foalim. halach ufasak lahem mezonot. ucheshebba etzel aviv, amar lo, beni, afillu im atta ose lahem kisuddat shelomo vishato, lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahen, shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov. ella ad shello yatchilu vammelacha tze veemor lahem, al menat sheen lachem alay ella fat vekitnit bilvad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo haya tzarich lomar, hakkol keminhag hammedina:
7.2: Veellu ochlin min hattora. haose vimchubbar lakkarka, bishat gemar melacha, uvetalush min hakkarka, ad shello nigmera melachto, bedavar sheggiddulo min haaretz. veellu sheen ochlin. haose vimchubbar lakkarka beshaa sheen gemar melacha, uvetalush min hakkarka meachar shennigmera melachto, uvedavar sheen giddulo min haaretz:
7.3: Haya ose veyadav aval lo veraglav, beraglav aval lo veyadav, afillu vichtefo, hare ze ochel. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyaase veyadav uveraglav:
7.4: Haya ose vitenim, lo yochal baanavim, baanavim, lo yochal bitenim. aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel. vechullan lo amru ella vishat melacha, aval mishshum hashev aveda labbealim amru, poalim ochlin bahalichatan meumman leumman, uvachaziratan min haggat, uvachamor keshehi foraket:
7.5: Ochel poel kishshut afillu vedinar, vechotevet afillu vedinar. rabbi elazar chisma omer, lo yochal poel yater al secharo. vachachamim mattirin, aval melammedin et haadam shello yehe raavtan vihe sotem et happetach befanav:
7.6: Kotzetz adam al yede atzmo, al yede veno uvitto haggedolim, al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim, al yede ishto, mippene sheyyesh bahen daat. aval eno kotzetz al yede veno uvitto hakketannim, velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim, velo al yede vehemto, mippene sheen bahen daat:
7.7: Hassocher et happoalim laasot beneta revai shello, hare ellu lo yochlu. im lo hodian, pode umaachilan. nitparsu iggulav, nitpattechu chaviyyotav, hare ellu lo yochlu. im lo hodian, measser umaachilan:
7.8: Shomre ferot ochlin mehilchot medina, aval lo min hattora. arbaa shomrin hen. shomer chinnam, vehashshoel, nose sachar, vehassocher. shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol, vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol, venose sachar vehassocher nishbaim al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva:
7.9: Zeev echad, eno ones, shene zeevim, ones. rabbi yehuda omer, bishat mishlachat zeevim, af zeev echad ones. shene chelavim, eno ones. yaddua habbavli omer mishshum rabbi meir, meruach achat, eno ones, mishshete ruchot, ones. hallistim, hare ze ones. haari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash, hare ze ones. ematay, bizman shebbau mealehen, aval im holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim, eno ones:
7.10: Meta chedarkah, hare ze ones. siggefah vameta, eno ones. alta lerashe tzukin venafla vameta, hare ze ones. heelah lerashe tzukin venafla vameta, eno ones. matne shomer chinnam lihyot patur mishshevua, vehashshoel lihyot patur milleshallem, nose sachar vehassocher lihyot peturin mishshevua umilleshallem:
7.11: Kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora, tenao vatel. vechol tenay sheyyesh maase vitchillato, tenao vatel. vechol sheefshar lo lekayyemo vesofo, vehitna alav mittechillato, tenao kayyam:

8.1: Hashshoel et happara veshaal bealeha immah o sachar bealeha imma. shaal habbealim o secharan, uleachar kach shaal et happara, vameta, patur, shenneemar (Shemot 22) im bealav immo lo yeshallem. aval shaal et happara veachar kach shaal et habbealim o secharan, vameta, chayyav, shenneemar (sham) bealav en immo shallem yeshallem:
8.2: Hashshoel et happara, shealah chatzi hayyom usecharah chatzi hayyom, shealah hayyom usecharah lemachar, sachar achat veshaal achat, vameta, hammashil omer sheula meta, bayyom shehayta sheula meta, bashshaa shehayta sheula meta, vehalla omer eni yodea, chayyav. hassocher omer sechura meta, bayyom shehayta sechura meta, bashshaa shehayta sechura meta, vehalla omer eni yodea, patur. ze omer sheula veze omer sechura, yishshava hassocher shessechura meta. ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea, yachaloku:
8.3: Hashshoel et happara, veshillechah lo beyad beno, beyad avdo, beyad shelucho, o veyad beno, beyad avdo, beyad shelucho shel shoel, vameta, patur. amar lo hashshoel, shallechah li beyad beni, beyad avdi, beyad sheluchi, o beyad bincha, beyad avdecha, beyad sheluchacha, o sheamar lo hammashil, hareni meshallechah lecha beyad beni, beyad avdi, beyad sheluchi, o beyad bincha, beyad avdecha, beyad sheluchacha, veamar lo hashshoel, shallach, veshillechah vameta, chayyav. vechen beshaa shemmachazirah:
8.4: Hammachalif para bachamor veyalda, vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda, ze omer ad shello macharti, veze omer mishshellakachti, yachaloku. hayu lo shene avadim, echad gadol veechad katan, vechen shete sadot, achat gedola veachat ketanna, hallokeach omer gadol lakachti, vehalla omer eni yodea, zacha vaggadol. hammocher omer katan macharti, vehalla omer eni yodea, en lo ella katan. ze omer gadol veze omer katan, yishshava hammocher shehakkatan machar. ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea, yachaloku:
8.5: Hammocher zetav leetzim, veasu pachot merviit lisa, hare ellu shel baal hazzetim. asu reviit lisa, ze omer zetay giddelu, veze omer artzi giddela, yachaloku. shataf nahar zetav unetanam letoch sede chavero, ze omer zetay giddelu, veze omer artzi giddela, yachaloku:
8.6: Hammaskir bayit lachavero, bimot haggeshamim, eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach, bimot hachamma, sheloshim yom. uvakkerakkim, echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim, shenem asar chodesh. uvachanuyot, echad ayarot veechad kerakkim, shenem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, chanut shel nachtomim veshel tzabbaim, shalosh shanim:
8.7: Hammaskir bayit lachavero, hammaskir chayyav baddelet, banneger, uvemanul, uvechol davar shemmaase umman. aval davar sheeno maase umman, hassocher osehu. hazzevel, shel baal habbayit, veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad:
8.8: Hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana, nitabbera hashshana, nitabbera lassocher. hiskir lo lechodashim, nitabbera hashshana, nitabbera lammaskir. maase vetzippori beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zahav leshana, middinar zahav lechodesh, uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose, veamru, yachaloku et chodesh haibbur:
8.9: Hammaskir bayit lachavero venafal, chayyav lehaamid lo bayit. haya katan, lo yaasennu gadol, gadol, lo yaasennu katan. echad, lo yaasennu shenayim, shenayim, lo yaasennu echad. lo yifchot mehachallonot velo yosif alehen, ella middaat shenehem:

9.1: Hamekabbel sade mechavero, mekom shennahagu liktzor, yiktzor, laakor, yaakor, lacharosh acharav, yacharosh. hakkol keminhag hammedina. keshem shecholkin battevua, kach cholkin batteven uvakkash. keshem shecholkin bayyayin, kach cholkin bazzemorot uvakkanim. ushenehem mesappekin et hakkanim:
9.2: Hamekabbel sade mechavero, vehi vet hashshelachin o vet hailan, yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan, eno menakke lo min chachoro. im amar lo chachor li sede vet hashshelachin ze o sede vet hailan ze, yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan, menakke lo min chachoro:
9.3: Hamekabbel sade mechavero vehovirah, shamin otah kamma reuya laasot venoten lo, shekkach kotev lo, im ovir velo aaved, ashallem bemetva:
9.4: Hamekabbel sade mechavero velo ratza lenakkesh, veamar lo ma ichpat lecha, hoil vaani noten lecha chachorah, en shomin lo, mippene sheyyachol lomar lo, lemachar atta yotze mimmenna, umaala lefanay asavim:
9.5: Hamekabbel sade mechavero velo asta, im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri, chayyav letappel bah. amar rabbi yehuda, ma kitzba vakkeri. ella im yesh bah kede nefila:
9.6: Hamekabbel sade mechavero vaachalah chagav o nishdefa, im makkat medina hi, menakke lo min chachoro, im eno makkat medina, eno menakke lo min chachoro. rabbi yehuda omer, im kibbelah hemennu vemaot, ben kach uven kach eno menakke lo mechachoro:
9.7: Hamekabbel sade mechavero baasara kor chittim leshana, lakta, noten lo mittochah. hayu chitteha yafot, lo yomar lo hareni lokeach min hashshuk, ella noten lo mittochah:
9.8: Hamekabbel sade mechavero lezarah seorim, lo yizraenna chittim, chittim, yizraenna seorim. rabban shimon ben gamliel oser. tevua, lo yizraenna kitnit, kitnit, yizraenna tevua. rabban shimon ben gamliel oser:
9.9: Hamekabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot, lo yizraenna fishtan, veen lo vekorat shikma. kibbelah hemennu lesheva shanim, shana rishona yizraenna fishtan, veyesh lo vekorat shikma:
9.10: Hamekabbel sade mechavero leshavua achat bishva meot zuz, hashsheviit min hamminyan. kibbelah hemennu sheva shanim bishva meot zuz, en hashsheviit min hamminyan:
9.11: Sechir yom gove chol hallayla, sechir layla gove chol hayyom, sechir shaot gove chol hallayla vechol hayyom. sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua, yatza vayyom, gove chol hayyom, yatza vallayla, gove chol hallayla vechol hayyom:
9.12: Echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim, yesh bo mishshum (Devarim kad) beyomo titten secharo, veyesh bo mishshum (Vayikra 19) lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker. ematay, bizman shettevao, lo tevao, eno over alav. himchahu etzel chenvani o etzel shulchani, eno over alav. sachir, bizmanno nishba venotel, avar zemanno eno nishba venotel. im yesh edim shettevao, hare ze nishba venotel. ger toshav yesh bo mishshum beyomo titten secharo, veen bo mishshum lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker:
9.13: Hammalve et chavero, lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din, velo yikkanes leveto littol mashkono, shenneemar (Devarim kad) bachutz taamod. hayu lo shene chelim, notel echad umanniach echad, umachazir et hakkar ballayla veet hammacharesha vayyom. veim met, eno machazir leyorshav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af leatzmo eno machazir ella ad sheloshim yom, umishsheloshim yom ulehallan mochran bevet din. almana, ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira, en memashkenin otah, shenneemar (Devarim kad) velo tachavol beged almana. hachovel et harechayim, over belo taase, vechayyav mishshum shene chelim, shenneemar (sham) lo yachavol rechayim varachev. velo rechayim varechev bilvad amru, ella chol davar sheosin bo ochel nefesh, shenneemar (Devarim kad) ki nefesh hu chovel:

10.1: Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu, shenehem cholkim baetzim uvaavanim uveafar, veroim elu avanim haruyot lehishtabber. im haya echad mehen makkir miktzat avanav, notlan veolot lo min hacheshbon:
10.2: Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim, nifchata haaliyya veen baal habbayit rotze letakken, hare vaal haaliyya yored vedar lematta, ad sheyyetakken lo et haaliyya. rabbi yose omer, hattachton noten et hattikra, vehaelyon et hammaaziva:
10.3: Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu, amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot, vehu eno rotze livnot, hare vaal haaliyya bone et habbayit vedar betocho ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav. rabbi yehuda omer, af ze dar betoch shel chavero, tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, ella vaal haaliyya bone et habbayit veet haaliyya umekare et haaliyya, veyoshev babbayit ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav:
10.4: Vechen bet habbad shehu vanuy besela, veginna achat al gabbav, venifchat, hare vaal hagginna yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase levet baddo kippin. hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku, patur milleshallem. natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel, venaflu betoch hazzeman, patur, leachar hazzeman, chayyav:
10.5: Mi shehaya chotlo samuch leginnat chavero venafal, veamar lo panne avanecha, veamar lo higgiucha, en shomin lo. mishshekkibbel alav amar lo helach et yetziotecha vaani ettol et shelli, en shomin lo. hassocher et happoel laasot immo beteven uvekash, veamar lo ten li sechari, veamar lo tol ma sheasita bischarecha, en shomin lo. mishshekkibbel alav veamar lo helach secharcha vaani ettol et shelli, en shomin lo. hammotzi zevel lirshut harabbim, hammotzi motzi vehamezabbel mezabbel. en shorin tit birshut harabbim, veen lovnim levenim. aval govlin tit birshut harabbim, aval lo levenim. habbone virshut harabbim, hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone. veim hizzik, meshallem ma shehizzik. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom:
10.6: Shete ginnot zo al gav zo vehayyarak bentayim, rabbi meir omer, shel elyon. rabbi yehuda omer, shel tachton. amar rabbi meir, im yirtze haelyon likkach et afaro en kan yarak. amar rabbi yehuda, im yirtze hattachton lemalleot et ginnato en kan yarak. amar rabbi meir, meachar sheshshenehen yecholin limchot ze al ze, roin mehechan yarak ze chay. amar rabbi shimon, kol shehaelyon yachol lifshot et yado velittol, hare hu shello, vehashshear shel tachton:
